versions.subject: add powershell_automated_collection.yml
versions.detection:
selection_eventid:
    EventID: 4104
selection_ext:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - '.doc'
        - '.docx'
        - '.xls'
        - '.xlsx'
        - '.ppt'
        - '.pptx'
        - '.rtf'
        - '.pdf'
        - '.txt'
selection_cmd:
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
        - 'Get-ChildItem'
        - ' -Recurse '
        - ' -Include '

condition: all of them
versions.spl: EventID=4104 ScriptBlockText IN ("*.doc*", "*.docx*", "*.xls*", "*.xlsx*", "*.ppt*", "*.pptx*", "*.rtf*", "*.pdf*", "*.txt*") ScriptBlockText="*Get-ChildItem*" ScriptBlockText="* -Recurse *" ScriptBlockText="* -Include *"
